title: Empty messages don't land interviews... 🔎
description:
Here's a hot take: recruiters aren't going to answer your generic messages. If you're looking for new work opportunity don't cold outreach to reacruiters, NETWORK. This will help build a rapport for referrals, especially with hiring managers. While hiring managers may not be as active on LinkedIn, they are more likely to move you to the front of the pile if they know who you are. #linkedin #linkedinrecruiter #linkedintips #linkedinprofile #recruiting #jobsearch #jobsearchtips
